description: The image shows a wide, smooth asphalt roadway with painted lane markings and a central yellow double line; there are no visible sidewalks or curb ramps, and the pedestrian path appears limited to a narrow roadside verge/strip beside the curb. A landscaped strip with low shrubs and young trees runs along the right, providing some separation from traffic, while tall streetlights line the roadway for lighting. There are no visible barriers, crosswalks, or pedestrian-specific accessibility features, so pedestrian comfort and safety would rely mainly on the curb/landscape edge rather than dedicated walk space.
